mapper.select:
select method_code.id as methodId, method_code.code as methodCode, method_config.name as methodName, method_config.image_asset_id as imageAssetId, media_asset.url as imageUrl, method_config.description as description, method_config.active as active, method_config.sort_no as sortOrder
from common_code method_code join code_group method_group on method_code.code_grp_id = method_group.id join pay_method_cfg method_config on method_config.method_id = method_code.id join media_asset media_asset on method_config.image_asset_id = media_asset.id
where method_group.group_code = 'PAYMENT_METHOD' order by method_config.sort_no asc

select method_code.code as paymentMethodCode, p.id AS paymentId, p.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, payment_status.code AS paymentStatus, order_status.code AS orderStatus, p.amount AS approvedAmount, p.paid_at AS approvedAt, o.waiting_order_no AS waitingOrderNo
from payment p join orders o ON o.id = p.order_id join common_code method_code on method_code.id = p.method_id
join common_code payment_status ON payment_status.id = p.status_id
join common_code order_status on order_status.id = o.status_id
where p.id = #{paymentId}

select order_status.code AS orderStatus, o.total_price AS totalPrice, o.order_no as orderNo from orders o join common_code order_status on order_status.id = o.status_id join code_group order_status_group on order_status_group.id = order_status.code_grp_id
where o.id = #{orderId} and order_status_group.group_code = 'ORDER_STATUS' FOR UPDATE

select exists ( select 1 FROM payment p JOIN common_code payment_status ON payment_status.id = p.status_id JOIN code_group payment_status_group ON payment_status_group.id = payment_status.code_grp_id WHERE p.order_id = #{orderId} AND payment_status.code = 'APPROVED' AND payment_status_group.group_code = 'PAYMENT_STATUS' )
mapper.insert:
insert into payment ( order_id, method_id, status_id, amount, paid_at, idempotency_key, provider_payment_key ) values( #{orderId}, #{methodId}, ( select payment_status.id from common_code payment_status join code_group payment_status_group on payment_status.code_grp_id = payment_status_group.id where payment_status_group.group_code = 'PAYMENT_STATUS' and payment_status.code = 'APPROVED' ), #{amount},
#{approvedAt}
now()
, #{idempotencyKey}, #{providerPaymentKey} )
mapper.update:
update orders o
join common_code current_status on current_status.id = o.status_id join code_group current_status_group on current_status.code_grp_id = current_status_group.id join common_code received_status on received_status.code = 'RECEIVED' join code_group received_status_group on received_status.code_grp_id = received_status_group.id
set o.status_id = received_status.id, o.waiting_date = #{watingDate}, o.waiting_order_no = #{waitingOrderNo}
where o.id = #{orderId} and received_status_group.group_code = 'ORDER_STATUS' and current_status.code = 'READY' and current_status_group.group_code = 'ORDER_STATUS'
mapper.insert: insert into daily_waiting_sequence ( waiting_date, last_waiting_order_no )values( #{watingDate}, 1 )on DUPLICATE KEY update last_waiting_order_no = last_waiting_order_no + 1
